ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast with approximately 70% high-intensity white regions and 30% low-intensity black/dark-gray regions concentrated medially.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large dark-intensity contiguous region centered at the peduncle junction, bifurcating into a V-shape. Extensive dark-intensity linear and mottled blobs are scattered across the mid-to-lateral regions of both lobes against a high-intensity background.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A wide, shallow V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 140 degrees; notch depth is approximately 8% of the total vertical extent of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency, varying-amplitude serrations. Notable sharp peaks and deep valleys (5-12 pixel depth variations) are continuous across the entire boundary from the medial notch to both distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The sweep exhibits a convex curve radiating from the center, transitioning to a slight taper at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dark-intensity clusters and irregular focal spots are visible along the distal tips and scattered across the lateral white regions, particularly on the right lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of multi-directional, low-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white high-intensity fields. Multiple parallel tracks (3-5 lines per set) are visible on the left lobe's medial-lateral transition.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across the ventral surface; distinct jagged erosion of the trailing edge and significant dark-intensity scarring on both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent 'X' shaped intersection of linear abrasions located in the upper-medial quadrant of the left lobe.
